turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How may I help you?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes, I just came in here today. I I've just been. Really getting like the soreness in my throat for the past, I would say four days and I also had a fever for the last two days as well.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. So the sore throat, have you been having  pain with swallowing foods or liquids?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm maybe a little bit with solids, not so much with liquids. But yeah, I definitely been feeling more sore.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Have you noticed any changes to your voice?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, no, not really, not. I haven't really notice any changes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uh, have you noticed any redness in the back of your mouth?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I've noticed some redness and then I also feel like there's like some material, like whitish material coming up from the back of my throat.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, this could be a uh, what they call a tonsillar exudate possibly, we'll look on physical exam. OK, does it look like there's swelling in the back of your mouth?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, it definitely looks angry.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you noticed any swelling in your neck as well like either on on the sides, like, or any lumps there?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, definitely like more on the front side of my neck on both sides. I feel kind of like some swelling and lumps.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And you've had a fever as well these last couple of days, so have you had any chills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I've had chills and then also been feeling warm during the day. I think yesterday I took a temperature at night and it was 38.4 degrees Celsius.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so yeah, certainly a fever. Have you had any night sweats?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Uhm, and have you had any headaches?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No headaches.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you had any eye redness or eye discharge?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any changes to your vision or hearing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any ear pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you had a runny nose or felt congested?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Last week I did have a little bit of a runny nose and a little bit of a cough as well, but this week I'm not really having any cough or runny nose, it's just a sore throat.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so the running nose and cough have gone away completely?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how long did those last for?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm probably like 5 days so it's I think it started two weeks ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And you're an are you having a cough now?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no cough right now.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uhm, and uh, OK, and have you had any changes to your sense of smell or sense of taste?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no they've both been the same.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any loss of appetite?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, no, my appetite's been pretty much the same I, I still try and I I do get hungry and I try to make sure, even though it hurts a little bit, to keep eating.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Uhm, and when you did have a cough, or during this time as well, have you coughed up any sputum or any blood?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uh, have you had any wheezing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, no wheezing.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, now have you had any shortness of breath?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no shortness of breath.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and then how about any chest pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no chest pain.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, so have you had any dizziness or lightheadedness?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Have you had any heart palpitations?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.text: Have you had any diarrhea?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Ah no.

turns.text: OK and have you had any urinary problems like pain with voiding or urinary frequency?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Uhm, have you had any rashes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you had any muscle aches or or joint pains?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no not that I know of.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Uhm, have you had any confusion or memory loss?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and have you had any changes to your energy? Like any fatigue or malaise?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm no, I don't think so. I'm still I still feel like pretty energetic.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. In the past have you been diagnosed with any medical conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no, I've been pretty healthy.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and do you take any medications regularly, either over the counter or prescribed?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you have any allergies?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not that I know of.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and do you have any? Are your immunizations up to date?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, as far as I know.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And, can you tell me a little about your living situation? So like where you're living and who you're living with?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I I live with my parents right now in a, in a house just in the city. And I also live with my older brother.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you been going to school?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, right now it's online school right now due to the pandemic.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and has anybody at home been sick or have you been around anybody who's been sick?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: My brother did have like similar sore throat symptoms, I think maybe two weeks ago and he did get some medications from the doctor.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so did he get antibiotics?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I think so. I think he got some antibiotics.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Have you traveled anywhere recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright and, I know if some people in your age group might experience with smoking or or alcohol. Have you or any of your friends tried anything like that before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and everything that we talk about is always confidential, so you can feel safe sharing with me, and so has there been any concerns with physical or emotional violence at home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I feel pretty safe. My parents are pretty caring and loving.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, well that's excellent. And are you sexually active?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you been sexually active in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not at all.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And now in the family, are there any conditions such as heart problems or lung problems that run in the family?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no. Like my parents are pretty healthy.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uhm, and any cancers that run in the family?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how's school going?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: School is going pretty well, no real issues. It took some time and adjusting to the new online curriculum, but it's going pretty well now.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, well that's good. I'm glad that you been able to, uh, adjust. So I think that was everything I wanted to ask about on history today. Did you have anything else that you maybe wanted to add? Or that I maybe forgot to ask about?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No. I think that those are all the questions I had.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so with your current symptoms right now with no cough, tonsillar exudate, a fever, also your age and the like swelling and redness that you notice in the back of your throat is likely a group a strep pharyngitis that's causing this. And with your exposure to your brother who also received antibiotics, could be potentially be a sick contact for you that you were around, so this would require antibiotics as well for yourself and we'll do a rapid strep antigen test to check for this and wait on the result for that because it it still could possibly be a viral illness and so that passes negative and we're thinking it's a viral illness then we might hold off on antibiotics for now and monitor symptoms. And if at any point things get worse like you start to get shortness of breath or your fever's getting worse and it's not, not being controlled, then we'll reeassess the situation.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK, sounds good. Thank you so much.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Thank you.
